implementations.name: dpa
implementations.notes: Drives src/poppy directly (PoppyClient, sign-in, conversations, APIs, operations) in Node; no model.

implementations.name: dpa-mock
implementations.notes: The mock Company from test/mock-company with its S2-lenient settings (strictAssertions off), the reference Company for attribution rule 2. Serves its recorded violations at GET /violations.

implementations.name: dpa-mock-strict
implementations.notes: The same image as dpa-mock with the mock's strict profile: assertion typ "JWT", a kid naming a published key and a 60-second lifetime (S2 jwt-60s), as the strictest live Companies require.

implementations.name: evil-agent
implementations.notes: The adversarial Personal Agent: the dpa-agent image with INTEROP_ADVERSARY=agent, armed with raw wire attacks (interop/impls/dpa-agent/attacks.ts). Runs only against our own owner:self Companies, never in the live lane (docs/adversarial-interop.md; SECURITY.md).

implementations.name: evil-company
implementations.notes: The adversarial Company: the dpa-mock image with INTEROP_ADVERSARY=company, reconfigured per attack by the arm hook. Runs only against our own owner:self agent, never in the live lane (docs/adversarial-interop.md; SECURITY.md).

implementations.name: datalayer-ts
implementations.notes: TypeScript SDK clients driven directly; no model. BSD-3-Clause.

implementations.name: datalayer-ts
implementations.notes: Manzanita reference Company on the TypeScript CompanyService. BSD-3-Clause.

implementations.name: datalayer-py
implementations.notes: Python SDK clients driven directly; no model. BSD-3-Clause.

implementations.name: datalayer-py
implementations.notes: Manzanita reference Company; hooks call the Python CompanyService in process. BSD-3-Clause.

implementations.name: pi-poppy
implementations.notes: Drives PersonalAgent (src/agent.ts) as the pi extension does; no model. Patch: private addresses under .interop.test. MIT.

implementations.name: pi-poppy
implementations.notes: CompanyServer (src/company.ts), the Company pi-poppy's tests use; nonces off until the require_nonce hook. Patch: private addresses under .interop.test. MIT.

implementations.name: poppy-demo
implementations.notes: workers/caller under wrangler dev; the adapter drives CallerSession's protocol actions through /api/action, never the model. One Company per process.

implementations.name: poppy-demo
implementations.notes: Northstar (workers/receiver) under wrangler dev; patched to admit *.agent.interop.test client_ids (INTEROP_PEER_SUFFIX).

implementations.name: poppyseed
implementations.notes: Reference Company (fixtures/next-app) with its own test hooks; consent through its real pages.

implementations.name: ilmer
implementations.notes: Signed-out only; wrangler dev without Workers AI, so replies are a fixed apology.

implementations.name: adonis-agora
implementations.notes: authkit-server 0.78.0 + @adonis-agora/agent 0.79.0 (Company conversations, agent commit e66a2329d436f603dd7c57a0ca81b36e65bd486f) in a minimal AdonisJS host; scripted model; allowInsecureClientIds on for private-network peers.

implementations.name: ilmer-live
implementations.notes: Live lane only: signed-out D, S0 and one or two C messages (a real model with a shared daily budget). Deployed commit not confirmed.

implementations.name: poppyseed-live
implementations.notes: Live lane only. On 11 October 2026 the apex 308-redirects to www., including POST /oauth/token, so S0 fails for agents that don't follow redirects with credentials. Deployed commit not confirmed.
